visualCharacteristics.purpose: Wistia testimonial video (5/12) beside a quote slider (7/12): red quote glyph, quote text, centred italic attribution, prev/next chevrons and dots
visualCharacteristics.description: carousel-product/-gallery are image/card sliders; this is a text-quote slider with dots paired with a fixed video pane. embed-wistia alone covers only the video.

contentPattern.summary: Wistia testimonial video (Evotec, 4:47) on the left (5/12) beside a 2-quote slider (red quote glyph, bold phrase, centered italic attribution, prev/next chevrons, dots) on the right (7/12)
contentPattern.structure: row 1 (block fields video_*): optional poster image + Wistia URL or id; then one row per quote (item `text`): quote paragraph(s) + italic attribution paragraph

reuseGuidance: Use for customer quotes next to a testimonial video. For a video alone use embed-wistia; for image/card sliders use carousel-product or carousel-gallery.
